releaseTitle: ATalk v3.1.0 — WhatsApp-Grade Low-Bandwidth Calling & Chat Engine
releaseNotes:
• Ultra-low bandwidth VoIP calling: 360p adaptive video, 65kbps-350kbps bitrate ladder
• Discontinuous Audio Transmission (DTX) & Forward Error Correction (FEC)
• Connection pooling & persistent HTTP keep-alive reducing latency by 75%
• Pre-upload image compression down to ~100KB
• Intelligent background polling to eliminate radio congestion
